name: breadcrumb
summary: Hierarchical trail that shows where a user is in a site's information architecture and lets them step back to any ancestor with a single click. Mirrors the master variant set on [Web-ODS Shared Library / 1260:8373](https://www.figma.com/design/0o8SL5BEk8wHtgud00dRyg/Web-ODS-Shared-Library?node-id=1260-8373&m=dev) and the companion [Spec Frame `1427:3565`](https://www.figma.com/design/0o8SL5BEk8wHtgud00dRyg/Web-ODS-Shared-Library?node-id=1427-3565&m=dev).

properties.name: items
properties.description: Ordered ancestors-to-current list. Each entry: `{ label: string, href?: string, ariaLabel?: string }`. The last entry becomes the `aria-current="page"` text node. When `collapsed=true` AND `items.length >= 4`, every entry between index 1 and `length - 2` is omitted from the DOM and represented by a single ellipsis placeholder.

properties.name: firstAsIcon
properties.description: When `true`, the first item renders as an icon-only home anchor (label → `aria-label`). When `false` AND `collapsed=false`, the first crumb is a plain text-link (no icon). When `false` AND `collapsed=true`, the first crumb is a text-link with a leading home icon next to the label (matches Figma `1260:8406`).

properties.name: collapsed
properties.description: When `true` AND `items.length >= 4`, hides every item between index 1 and `length - 2` from the DOM and inserts a single ellipsis placeholder directly before the parent-of-current crumb. The placeholder is static (no JS) — its tooltip + `aria-label` enumerate the hidden labels.

properties.name: truncation
properties.description: When `true`, caps each label at `max-inline-size: 12ch` and ellipsizes overflow. Applies to intermediate links and the current page text alike.

properties.name: ariaLabel
properties.description: Bound to the root `<nav aria-label="…">`. Localize when shipping.

properties.name: hiddenPagesLabel
properties.description: Code-only. Accessibility label string — the prefix for the ellipsis placeholder's `aria-label`, rendered as `"<hiddenPagesLabel>: <comma-separated hidden labels>"`. Only emitted when `collapsed=true`. No Figma component-property counterpart (an a11y string, not a designer-set value). Localize when shipping.

properties.name: iconType
properties.description: Code-only. The icon catalog key used for BOTH the icon-only and leading-home shapes of the first crumb. No Figma component-property counterpart — in Figma the home glyph is an instance-swap of the Icon component, not an enum of catalog keys. Defaults to the canonical home glyph; override for category-specific anchors (e.g. `business/simple-storefront`).

properties.name: items[].kind
properties.description: Helper-derived. One of `link` / `current` / `separator` / `ellipsis`, assigned by `buildCrumbsFromItems` when it expands the consumer trail into the rendered sequence. Drives the per-crumb branch in `breadcrumb.hbs`.

properties.name: items[].label
properties.description: Consumer-set on `link` / `current` entries; the visible crumb text.

properties.name: items[].href
properties.description: Consumer-set on `link` entries; the crumb anchor target.

properties.name: items[].homeIconOnly
properties.description: Helper-derived. Set on the first crumb when `firstAsIcon=true`; renders the icon-only home anchor (label → `aria-label`).

properties.name: items[].leadingHomeIcon
properties.description: Helper-derived. Set on the first crumb when `collapsed=true` AND `firstAsIcon=false`; renders the leading home glyph beside the label.

properties.name: items[].ariaLabel
properties.description: Consumer-set (optional) on the first item; becomes the icon-only home anchor's accessible name when `homeIconOnly` is set.

properties.name: items[].hiddenLabels
properties.description: Helper-derived. Comma-joined labels of the folded middle items; carried on the `ellipsis` entry for the placeholder's `title` + `aria-label`.

properties.name: items[].hiddenPagesLabel
properties.description: Helper-derived from the top-level `hiddenPagesLabel` prop; prefixes the ellipsis placeholder's `aria-label`.

accessibility: Trail uses an ordered list (`<ol>` / `<li>`) so screen readers
The current page entry is a `<span aria-current="page">` — never
Separator icons carry `aria-hidden="true"` via the composed `icon`
When `collapsed=true`, the ellipsis placeholder is a
Touch targets: the home-icon anchor meets the WCAG 2.5.5 / Apple
BreadcrumbList schema.org markup is intentionally **not** baked
